outcome: Experiment Authoring now has a real syntax-highlighted code editor foundation
owner_impact: Configuration, Initialization, Controller and Metrics are edited through an Ace code-editor surface with line numbers, Python syntax highlighting, normal selection/undo/redo/clipboard behavior and preserved responsive styling. The existing artifact textareas remain the authoritative source buffers underneath, so dirty-state, autosave, Apply & restart, revision history and read-only Experiment behavior keep their established semantics.

next.text: #204 is the next code-authoring ergonomics ticket. It adds parser-derived outline/symbol navigation, folding and reliable in-artifact search on top of this editor foundation. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: Ace 1.44.0 is loaded as one standalone zero-dependency browser editor runtime; the existing textarea remains the fallback if editor initialization fails.
The deployed Python-like artifact formats use Ace Python mode for syntax highlighting; no Virtual Lab scientific names are hardcoded as fake semantic tokens.

Ace edits mirror into the authoritative textareas through the existing input contract, while authoritative Experiment/revision loads reset editor content and undo history without manufacturing dirty edits.
Read-only state is mirrored from the existing artifact textareas into Ace.
The existing interaction-boundary autosave logic treats the Ace surface as inside the artifact editor.
Production browser smoke requires four ready Ace surfaces, hidden authoritative fallback textareas, line numbers and rendered highlighted tokens, and reports exact editor initialization errors.
